questions.text: Match each student with the most useful notice.
questions.explanation: 1) A first-year student needs help finding academic books. — Оголошення присвячене роботі з бібліотечним каталогом. Приклад: LIBRARY ORIENTATION: Learn how to search the catalogue, reserve textbooks and use online journals. 2) A student wants guidance on choosing a career. — Кар'єрна консультація допоможе визначитися з професією. Приклад: CAREERS OFFICE: Book a meeting to discuss professional interests, training routes and job applications. 3) A student has missed lessons due to illness and needs support. — Служба допомагає наздогнати навчання після пропусків. Приклад: STUDENT SUPPORT: Contact your tutor to arrange missed assignments and access course materials. 4) A student wants to improve public speaking skills. — Дебатний клуб розвиває навички публічного мовлення. Приклад: DEBATE CLUB: Practise making clear arguments and responding confidently to questions.

pairs: A first-year student needs help finding academic books.
LIBRARY ORIENTATION: Learn how to search the catalogue, reserve textbooks and use online journals.
A student wants guidance on choosing a career.
CAREERS OFFICE: Book a meeting to discuss professional interests, training routes and job applications.
A student has missed lessons due to illness and needs support.
STUDENT SUPPORT: Contact your tutor to arrange missed assignments and access course materials.
A student wants to improve public speaking skills.
DEBATE CLUB: Practise making clear arguments and responding confidently to questions.

questions.text: Match the headings with the paragraphs about learning.
questions.explanation: 1) Learning from feedback — Переопрацювання тексту спирається на коментарі викладача. Приклад: After receiving comments on her essay, Priya rewrote the introduction. Her second draft was clearer because she addressed each suggestion. 2) Balancing study and rest — Ідея полягає в чергуванні занять і перерв. Приклад: Noah divides his afternoons into focused sessions and short breaks. He finds that this schedule helps him remember material without feeling exhausted. 3) Practical experience before graduation — Виробнича практика пов'язує теорію з реальними задачами. Приклад: During the summer, Lena worked with engineers on a local project. She applied classroom knowledge to real technical problems. 4) Studying with others — Групова робота допомагає взаємному поясненню. Приклад: Four classmates meet online every Thursday to compare notes. They explain difficult topics to one another instead of memorising answers alone.

pairs: Learning from feedback

Noah divides his afternoons into focused sessions and short breaks. He finds that this schedule helps him remember material without feeling exhausted.

questions.text: Match the education term with its definition.
questions.explanation: 1) curriculum — Curriculum — навчальна програма. Приклад: The complete set of subjects and learning goals in a course. 2) assessment — Assessment — оцінювання досягнень. Приклад: A process used to measure how well someone has learned. 3) scholarship — Scholarship — стипендія або освітній грант. Приклад: Financial support awarded to help a learner continue studying. 4) prerequisite — Prerequisite — попередня обов'язкова умова. Приклад: Something that must be completed before a course can be taken.

pairs: curriculum
The complete set of subjects and learning goals in a course.
assessment
A process used to measure how well someone has learned.
scholarship
Financial support awarded to help a learner continue studying.
prerequisite
Something that must be completed before a course can be taken.

questions.text: Match the employment term with its definition.
questions.explanation: 1) vacancy — Vacancy — вільна вакансія. Приклад: A job position that an employer currently needs to fill. 2) probation — Probation — випробувальний строк. Приклад: An initial period during which an employee's suitability is evaluated. 3) promotion — Promotion — підвищення на посаді. Приклад: Moving to a job with greater responsibility or seniority. 4) reference — Reference — рекомендація для роботодавця. Приклад: A recommendation or statement about someone's work or character.

pairs: vacancy

probation

questions.text: Match each workplace request with a suitable response.
questions.explanation: 1) Could you clarify the deadline for the report? — Clarify the deadline означає уточнити конкретний термін. Приклад: The completed document must reach me by Friday at noon. 2) Would it be possible to work remotely tomorrow? — Remote work — виконання роботи з дому. Приклад: Yes, you may complete your duties from home for one day. 3) May I have some feedback on my presentation? — Feedback — коментарі щодо якості виконаної роботи. Приклад: Your evidence was strong, but the conclusion could be more concise. 4) Could we postpone the meeting until next week? — Postpone означає відкласти подію. Приклад: Certainly; I'll move it to Tuesday at ten.

pairs: Could you clarify the deadline for the report?
The completed document must reach me by Friday at noon.
Would it be possible to work remotely tomorrow?
Yes, you may complete your duties from home for one day.
May I have some feedback on my presentation?
Your evidence was strong, but the conclusion could be more concise.
Could we postpone the meeting until next week?
Certainly; I'll move it to Tuesday at ten.

questions.text: Match each expression with its professional meaning.
questions.explanation: 1) meet a deadline — Meet a deadline — встигнути до визначеного терміну. Приклад: Finish an assigned task by the agreed time. 2) take on responsibility — Take on — взяти на себе обов'язок. Приклад: Agree to be accountable for an additional duty. 3) carry out research — Carry out research — проводити дослідження. Приклад: Conduct a systematic investigation into a question. 4) draw a conclusion — Draw a conclusion — дійти висновку. Приклад: Form a judgement based on information or evidence.

pairs: meet a deadline
Finish an assigned task by the agreed time.
take on responsibility
Agree to be accountable for an additional duty.
carry out research
Conduct a systematic investigation into a question.

questions.text: Match the headings with the paragraphs about society.
questions.explanation: 1) Making public spaces accessible — Доступність просторів завдяки фізичним змінам. Приклад: The council installed ramps and clearer signs near the station. Residents with different mobility needs can now use the entrance more easily. 2) Encouraging local participation — Громадяни беруть участь у прийнятті місцевих рішень. Приклад: Residents were invited to suggest improvements at an open meeting. Several of their ideas were added to next year's budget proposal. 3) Supporting people who change careers — Перекваліфікація та підтримка дорослих. Приклад: A charity offers evening classes to adults seeking different jobs. Participants can also practise interview skills with volunteers. 4) Reducing unequal access to information — Скорочення цифрової нерівності. Приклад: The town opened a free internet centre near the market. People without home connections can now apply for services online.

pairs: Making public spaces accessible

questions.text: Match each organisational problem with the most appropriate measure.
questions.explanation: 1) Staff turnover has risen sharply. — Turnover персоналу — частота звільнень і заміни працівників. Приклад: Introduce regular development discussions and investigate why employees leave. 2) A company cannot prove how decisions are made. — Transparency вимагає зрозумілих критеріїв та обліку рішень. Приклад: Publish clear criteria and document the selection process. 3) Employees report that a new rule is applied unfairly. — Справедливий розгляд скарг потребує незалежного механізму. Приклад: Establish an independent procedure for reviewing complaints. 4) Different departments have conflicting priorities. — Узгодження цілей різних команд зменшує суперечки. Приклад: Hold a joint planning meeting and agree on measurable shared goals.

pairs: Staff turnover has risen sharply.
Introduce regular development discussions and investigate why employees leave.
A company cannot prove how decisions are made.
Publish clear criteria and document the selection process.
Employees report that a new rule is applied unfairly.
Establish an independent procedure for reviewing complaints.
Different departments have conflicting priorities.
Hold a joint planning meeting and agree on measurable shared goals.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: community, volunteer, charity. Our local (1)___ organised a clean-up near the river. I decided to (2)___ at the event instead of staying home. The organisers were a small (3)___ that supports environmental projects.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: citation, plagiarism, enrolment, credentials. Before the course began, students completed online (1)___. questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: incentive, retention, turnover, appraisal. A company noticed that staff (1)___ was increasing, with many employees leaving after one year. To improve worker (2)___, the management introduced more flexible schedules. questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: accessibility, inequality, outreach, policy. The town's digital services were difficult for many older residents to use. Officials recognised that this created an information (1)___. They introduced a new (2)___ requiring clearer websites. Local libraries organised (3)___ visits to teach residents how to use the online forms. The changes improved (4)___ for people with different needs.
questions.explanation: (1) inequality — Inequality — нерівність у доступі до можливостей. (2) policy — Policy — встановлена організаційна чи державна політика. (3) outreach — Outreach visits — активні виїзні заходи для допомоги громадам. (4) accessibility — Accessibility — доступність сервісів для різних користувачів.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: grievance, compliance, mediation, legislation. New employment (1)___ required companies to update workplace rules. questions.explanation: (1) legislation — Legislation — законодавство, що встановлює правила. (2) compliance — Compliance with requirements — дотримання вимог. (3) grievance — Grievance — офіційна скарга працівника. (4) mediation — Mediation — переговори за участю незалежного посередника.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: stakeholders, accountability, transparent, consensus. The project affected students, teachers and local employers, all of whom were important (1)___. The committee wanted its decisions to be (2)___, so it published clear selection criteria. After several meetings, the members reached a (3)___ on the final budget. They also introduced public reporting to ensure greater (4)___ for the results.
questions.explanation: (1) stakeholders — Stakeholders — усі сторони, на яких впливають рішення. (2) transparent — Transparent — відкритий і зрозумілий для перевірки. (3) consensus — Reach a consensus — дійти спільної згоди. (4) accountability — Accountability — підзвітність за дії та результати.
